_note: Manual-level settings for the generic example aircraft (redesign/fusion/examples). Not a design.
title: Example aircraft build manual
subtitle: Generic test geometry: fuselage box, wing with spar and aileron, two booms with lift motors

work_packages.title: Fuselage
work_packages.summary: Inserts and ESC in the fuselage box.

work_packages.title: Wing
work_packages.summary: Spar bond, aileron hinge and servo. One overnight cure.

work_packages.title: Booms and motors
work_packages.summary: Motors onto the booms, booms clamped under the wing.

work_packages.title: Final assembly
work_packages.summary: Wing onto the fuselage, leads connected, battery in last.

safety.title: LiPo
safety.text: Battery goes in last (step 6). Charge only in a LiPo bag, never unattended. A swollen or dented pack is not used.

safety.title: Props
safety.text: No propeller on any motor during bench work. Props go on only for a test on the stand or a tied-down airframe.

safety.title: Heat and fumes
safety.text: Insert iron and soldering iron run at 220-350 °C: heat-proof mat, fan or extraction on.

safety.title: Epoxy
safety.text: Nitrile gloves, ventilated room. Mix on a card, not in a cup (heat builds up in a mass of epoxy).
